description: React component for a user guide dropdown menu in Mattermost web application, including links to documentation, training resources, community support, and keyboard shortcuts modal.

classes.name: UserGuideDropdown
classes.description: React component class for the user guide dropdown menu, managing state and rendering menu items with links and actions.

methods.name: openKeyboardShortcutsModal
methods.description: Opens the keyboard shortcuts modal dialog.

methods.name: buttonToggleState
methods.description: Updates the active state of the button/menu.

methods.name: renderDropdownItems
methods.description: Renders the menu items including links and plugin items.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire dropdown menu component.
